sources.role: cap32.cfg parser, SDL joystick enumeration and hard-coded event translation

paths.naming: cap32.cfg is a generated key/value file with [section] headers and key=value entries; preserve the existing file.

paths.path: cap32.cfg [system] joystick keys plus SDL joystick subsystem; the first eight devices are opened and event instances 0/1 are CPC joystick ports 0/1
paths.naming: Writer patches joysticks=1, joystick_emulation=0 and one-based menu/virtual-keyboard buttons; axes 0/2 and 1/3 plus buttons 0/1 are source-fixed, and physical identity requires a same-launch instance probe.

paths.path: ROM/disk directory; CPC disk writes use .dsk and snapshots use .sna
paths.naming: CPC disk writes remain in .dsk media; no separate battery-save sidecar is documented.
